ballot_text.source_title: Measure 115: Amends Constitution: Authorizes impeachment of statewide elected officials by Oregon Legislature with two-thirds vote by each House; establishes process (House Joint Resolution 16, referred 2023)
ballot_text.type_quote: Amends Constitution: Authorizes impeachment of statewide elected officials by Oregon Legislature with two-thirds vote by each House; establishes process

fact.quote: The House of Representatives may deliver a resolution of impeachment to the Senate only upon the concurrence of at least two-thirds of all Representatives.
fact.why: The measure's own text sets a two-thirds (66.7%) requirement for an act: the House may send an impeachment resolution only on two-thirds of all Representatives (40 of 60, per the summary), and subsection (2) adds 'A person may not be convicted under this section without the concurrence of at least two-thirds of all Senators' (20 of 30). Applies is true on the brief's definition (the measure's text sets a greater-than-majority requirement). Note for D3: the two-thirds is a requirement on legislative votes the measure creates; I could not read Or. Const. art. II sec. 23(1) itself (oregonlegislature.gov refused, 403), so whether sec. 23(1) reaches a requirement of this kind is D3's call.
